variants.headline: Still in view: building project badly behind schedule
variants.sub: Construction of a building project is severely delayed in {colony}.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. A building project in the colony is badly behind schedule.

We defend {target} against a verdict based on the delay alone. Lateness is established, but its existence does not prove every adverse claim about responsibility or the merits of the project.
